newsitem.title: MALI: Randgold strikes new gold in Mali.
newsitem.headline: Randgold strikes new gold in Mali.

text.p: South Africa's Randgold Resources has struck gold at Yalea in southern Mali during trench surveys which indicated up to 4.2 grammes per tonne of ore, Mali's Ministry of Mines said on Friday.
No indication of estimated total reserves were given, a ministry spokesman told Reuters.
Gold mining has expanded rapidly in Mali and other African countries since 1990 as governments have opened mining to foreign investment.
Mali's total gold exports could rise from 7 tonnes of gold in 1996 to 17 tonnes in 1997 as new mines built up production, the spokesman added.
Gold export earnings totalled 35 billion CFA in 1995, he said.
Randgold is also building up production at its Syama gold mine, one of Mali's largest, as well as exploring reserves at Loulo -- not far from Yalea. --Matthew Bunce, Abidjan newsroom + 225 21 90 90
